prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: original environment-detail animation atlas for a native SNES cartoon office fighting game.
Primary request: Draw an exactly SIX COLUMN by THREE ROW contact sheet of small stage props, with genuinely transparent background, no borders or words. Each of the eighteen cells has the same size. Each cell shows FOUR clearly separated tiny props left-to-right, all fitting in the same positions across a row. Flat hand-pixelled cartoon, dark navy outlines, restrained warm colors. These become quiet 16x16 pixel background patches; simple strong silhouettes, no glows.
Row1 Las Condes lobby details: potted narrow leafy shrub, glass door leaf with gold vertical handle, second potted shrub, tiny warmly lit lobby panel. Six columns: still, subtle leaves/door opening, leaves lightly bending with open door, still leaves with door half closed, leaves bending more and lit panel, settled welcoming open door.
Row2 El Castillo patio details: potted leafy shrub, hanging paper lantern, another leafy shrub, two small triangular party pennants on one line. Six columns: still, mild breeze, breeze to left, breeze right, a slightly stronger breeze, settled pennants angled upward in celebration. No confetti.
Row3 La Oficina desk details: small computer monitor showing abstract blocks with navy bezel, potted desk plant, another small monitor with navy bezel, office door leaf with brass handle. Six columns: still normal screens, screen blocks change/leaves sway, screen blocks change/leaves bend slightly, screens show a subtle warm alert square/leaves right, screens bright gold abstract bars/leaves left, screens return calm/door slightly ajar. NO readable text, no digits, no logos.
Constraints: six columns three rows, each cell repeats its own row's exact same four prop identities and footprints. Transparent background including between props, no floor, no people, no labels, no captions, original artwork only.
use: Original atlas; deterministic alpha crop, downsample and fixed existing-stage palette conversion only.
